description: Explicit pre-ride recovery. Keeps an already-ready connection, otherwise performs one bounded power cycle and waits for a new, fresh FTMS measurement. Do not run while riding.

if.value_template: {{ before.status_read_failed | default(false) or before.recording_ready is not defined or before.last_activity_ts is not defined }}

data.title: Bike status unavailable
data.message: The bike and recorder status could not be checked. Check FTMS diagnostics before starting; recovery was not attempted.

then.stop: Bike status must be known before power recovery.

data.title: Bike ready
data.message: Checked {{ now().strftime('%H:%M:%S') }}: fresh bike data is being recorded. This notice clears when recording becomes unavailable.

then.stop: Bike is already recording fresh telemetry.

data.title: Bike recorder needs attention
data.message: The bike connection is fresh but the recorder is unhealthy ({{ before.storage_error | default('unknown storage error') }}). No power cycle was attempted.

then.stop: Fresh telemetry with an unhealthy recorder needs diagnosis first.

if.value_template:
{{ before.last_activity_ts is not none and
   (as_timestamp(now()) - (before.last_activity_ts | float(0))) < 180 }}

data.title: Bike recovery skipped
data.message: Recent pedalling was observed. Check the bike before using Start Ride again.

then.stop: Recent activity makes a power cycle unsafe.

data.title: Bike recovery unavailable
data.message: Smart Plug 5 is unavailable. No power-cycle was attempted.

data.title: Connecting the bike
data.message: Trying one pre-ride recovery. Please wait for Bike ready before pedalling; allow up to two minutes.

data.title: Bike power recovery failed
data.message: Smart Plug 5 did not report on. Check the plug and bike power before riding.

then.stop: Smart Plug 5 did not restore bike power.

data.title: Bike ready
data.message: Checked {{ now().strftime('%H:%M:%S') }}: fresh bike data is being recorded. This notice clears when recording becomes unavailable.

data.title: Bike connection failed
data.message: No fresh, persisted FTMS measurement arrived within 90 seconds. Bike power is on. Wake the console and check the Bluetooth adapter and integration status.

else.stop: No fresh FTMS telemetry arrived before the deadline.
